title: ClaimSetCandidateRejectedV1
description: Payload of the canonical, self-contained, NON-claim-bearing claim_set_candidate_rejected event. Rejection appends no accepted claim-bearing event: it advances canonical_event_log_digest and leaves claim_projection_digest unchanged. Replay rebuilds a local rejection-tombstone index from these events. The event is never deleted or rewritten. See docs/specs/state-machine-resolver-v1-runtime-architecture.md section 5.4.

rejection_fingerprint.description: Hashes normalized semantic Claim content plus Product and semantic scope. Excludes source location, provider identity, timestamp, and candidate ID, so the tombstone survives SQLite deletion and restart. Changed semantics produce a new fingerprint and surface normally. Automatic ingest must never silently resurface an exact match.

reason_code.description: Closed. An unknown reason fails closed rather than being stored as free text.

reconsideration_of.description: Optional. Set when an explicit human reconsideration creates a new generation referencing a prior rejection event.
